final_message:
Implemented `parse_quote`, `pick_best`, `Quote.total`, and `FreightClient`. 27 of 28 tests pass.

The one failure is `tests/test_client.py::test_live_quote_for_standard_pallet`. It calls the real rate service, and this sandbox has no route to it (the proxy returns 403). It will fail the same way in CI without network access. I left it alone since it's your test; you may want to mark it to skip without network or move it behind a marker.

Changes:
- `freight/quote.py`: `Quote.total` rounds half up to cents. `parse_quote` validates the JSON per the README and accepts string or numeric amounts. `pick_best` checks currencies across all quotes before applying the transit limit, then picks by total, transit days, and carrier name.
- `freight/client.py`: `FreightClient` validates ports and weight before any request, builds the URL, and maps HTTP 404 to `NoRouteError`. Other HTTP and network errors become `QuoteError("rate service unavailable: ...")`. The default transport uses `urllib.request.urlopen`.

blocker: sandbox has no route to it (the proxy returns 403
